chat.title: Assistant
chat.placeholder: Ask for an action or a question…
chat.empty: Describe what you want to build: the assistant can create nodes, wire them, write prompts and launch generations right in the workflow.
chat.homeEmpty: Describe the project you want: the assistant creates the project and video, picks the art direction and builds the whole workflow. E.g. “Create a 2.5-minute anime project about…”
chat.needKey: Add your kie.ai API key in Integrations on the home page to enable the assistant.
chat.fixPromptPrefill:
The generation of node “{{label}}” failed with: {{error}}
Analyze this node's prompt, fix it to avoid that error while staying true to the intent, update the node, then relaunch the generation.
chat.adjustPromptPrefill:
The output of node “{{label}}” doesn't work for me: 

Improve the prompt accordingly, update the node, then relaunch the generation.

onboarding.welcomeText: Create AI videos through workflows: designs, storyboard, shots and music come together on one canvas. Three steps to get started.
onboarding.keyExplain: One key powers everything — image, video and music generation, credit balance and the assistant. Get it on

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupHint: .raccord archive containing the database and all media. API keys don't transfer to another machine (local encryption).
settings.backupImportConfirm: Replace all current data (projects, videos, media) with this backup? The app will restart. The previous database is kept as a .bak next to the new one.
settings.channelHint: The beta channel receives new features early (beta flags on by default). Only applies to the installed app — in development the channel is always "dev".

updateStatus.up-to-date: The app is up to date.

settings.notifyOnCompletionHint: Show a system notification when a generation finishes while the app is in the background.
